description: This file defines a Flutter widget for a location search bottom sheet, allowing users to type a destination and select from suggestions or enter a custom location. It matches certain features of a Kotlin 'LocationSearchFragment' and provides UI elements such as a search bar, suggestions list, and callback handling.

classes.name: LocationSearchSheet
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that displays a bottom sheet for searching locations. It includes a callback for when a destination is selected.

classes.name: _LocationSearchSheetState
classes.description: State class managing the search input, suggestion list filtering, and UI building for the search sheet.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the filtered suggestions list upon widget creation.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the search controller when the widget is removed.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI of the search sheet, including handle bar, header text, search input, and suggestions list.

methods.name: _onSearchChanged
methods.description: Filters suggestions based on user input.

methods.name: _onSearchSubmitted
methods.description: Handles the event when user submits the search query, calling the callback and closing the sheet.
